items.title: Emmett Johnson: Another TD in Week 12 loss
items.text:
Johnson rushed 17 times for 72 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 24 yards in the Chiefs' 13-10 loss to the Bills on Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Allen: Stymied by Chiefs in win
items.text:
Allen completed 10 of 21 passes for 81 yards with no touchdowns and two interceptions and added seven carries for 43 yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: James Cook: Thrives in workhorse role
items.text:
Cook rushed 32 times for 117 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for eight yards in the Bills' 13-10 win over the Chiefs on Thursday.

items.title: DeVonta Smith: Limping after Thursday's game
items.text:
Smith (back) was seen limping badly in the locker room after Thursday's 39-38 win over the Cowboys, Martin Frank of the Delaware News Journal reports.

items.title: Dallas Goedert: Seen with right arm in sling
items.text:
Goedert (shoulder) had his right arm in a sling following Thursday's 39-38 victory over the Cowboys, Jimmy Kempski of PhillyVoice.com reports.

items.title: George Pickens: Five grabs in loss to Philly
items.text:
Pickens caught five of nine targets for 67 yards in Thursday's 39-38 loss to the Eagles.
